question: Find the simplified value of [ (17 times 3) times left{ 7 div 7 times (18 - (14)/(2)) right} ].
solution:
**Given:**

[ (17 times 3) times left{ 7 div 7 times (18 - (14)/(2)) right} ].

**Formula used:**

Simplify using the BODMAS rule.

**Calculations:**

[ (17 × 3) × { 7 ÷ 7 × (18 - (14 ÷ 2)) } ]

⇒ [ (17 × 3) × { 7 ÷ 7 × (18 - 7) } ]

⇒ [ (17 × 3) × { 7 ÷ 7 × 11 } ]

⇒ [ (17 × 3) × { 1 × 11 } ]

⇒ [ (17 × 3) × 11 ]

⇒ (51 × 11)

⇒ 561

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
